risks.title: Intense competition and loss of market share
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned early and detailed across multiple paragraphs. The language used emphasizes its severity. It is presented as a major factor affecting growth and profitability.

risks.title: Regulation of independent worker status
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly cited as potentially having a material effect on the company. Regulatory uncertainty and potential impact on costs are key elements.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and data breaches
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions past incidents and anticipates future attacks, highlighting potential impact on operations, reputation, and litigation. Severity is heightened by reference to critical systems and third-party providers.

risks.title: Difficulty maintaining profitability and cost management
risks.score_rationale: This risk is underscored by the history of net losses and expectation of increasing expenses. Inability to achieve or sustain profitability is a central concern.

risks.title: Dependence on and retention of delivery personnel
risks.score_rationale: The risk is clearly stated: inability to attract and retain delivery workers. Impact on business, financial condition, and results is direct. Availability and cost of delivery workers are crucial.

risks.title: Volatility of results and difficult forecasting
risks.score_rationale: The text indicates that results fluctuate on a quarterly and annual basis, making forecasting difficult. While less critical than others, it affects planning and investor perception.

risks.title: Impact of general economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned as affecting consumer spending and merchant operations. Unfavorable economic conditions are a major external factor cited in the document.

ai_positioning.summary: DoorDash does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The information provided focuses primarily on financial aspects, acquisitions, and relationships with customers, merchants, and delivery workers, with no specific reference to AI technologies.
